structured.feedback: The description is about 240 words, with clear Markdown subheadings, active voice and a call to action. It has no links or invented quotes, and it leaves out the rust and see-through complaints. Its claims match the listing and reviews (two heads, two scrapers, no priming needed, 28mm, replacement insert, sturdy scrapers). Minor issues: the feature-versus-benefit split is blended, and "suits most nail shapes" is slightly embellished.
